svg.title: Ramanujan nested radical spiraling to Catalan's constant
svg.desc: A logarithmic polar spiral projection of the recursion. Each depth of the nested radical is plotted at angle theta=d*0.55 and radius proportional to log distance from the limit value 4. The trajectory spirals inward and the partial G estimate converges to Catalan's constant 0.9159655941...
svg.text: Polar log-spiral: angle = depth, radius = distance from fixed point 4
